# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.2 Worker 2: Middle Kingdom laws, celestial cabinet actions, track decisions and advances (oe_cel_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v112_celestial_laws.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Gaituguiliu Commissioner (ADM, province target): speeds assimilation and control in one own province.
oe_cel_cab_gaituguiliu_commission = {
	ability = adm
	helps_with = "location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
	}

	allow = {
		num_locations > 0
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_cel_cab_gaituguiliu_commission_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_cel_cab_gaituguiliu_commission_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				controller ?= scope:actor
			}
			NOT = {
				cabinet_already_performing_same_task_on_target = {
					cabinet_action = oe_cel_cab_gaituguiliu_commission
					interaction_target = target
				}
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = 0.25
		local_monthly_control = 0.01
	}

	map_marker = {
		show_for_owner = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 5 }
	}
}

# 2. Protectorate Supply Lines (DIP, country target): one grand protectorate gets a loyalty modifier while active.
oe_cel_cab_duhu_logistics = {
	ability = dip
	helps_with = "subject"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
	}

	allow = {
		any_subject = { is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu }
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				every_subject = {
					add_to_list = source
				}
			}
		}
		name = "oe_cel_cab_duhu_logistics_select_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_cel_cab_duhu_logistics_no_countries"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	country_modifier = {
		naval_range_modifier = 0.05
	}

	on_activate = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			scope:target = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_duhu_supplied_mod mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	on_deactivate = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			scope:target = {
				remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_duhu_supplied_mod
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 4 }
	}
}

# 3. Assembly of the Commissions (DIP, no target): every commission and tusi subject gets a loyalty modifier.
oe_cel_cab_lifan_assembly = {
	ability = dip
	helps_with = "subject"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
	}

	allow = {
		oe_cel_has_valid_gaituguiliu_target = yes
	}

	country_modifier = {
		monthly_celestial_authority = 0.005
	}

	on_activate = {
		scope:actor = {
			every_subject = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi
						is_subject_type = tusi
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_lifan_assembly_mod mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	on_fully_activated = {
		scope:actor = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.17
		}
	}

	on_deactivate = {
		scope:actor = {
			every_subject = {
				limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_cel_lifan_assembly_mod }
				remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_lifan_assembly_mod
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 4 }
	}
}
